description: This file contains utility functions for handling POSIX signals within Apache Spark, including registering signal handlers, logging signals, and managing signal actions.

classes.name: SignalUtils
classes.description: Object providing utilities for POSIX signal handling, including registering signal handlers and managing signal actions.

classes.name: ActionHandler
classes.description: Private class that manages actions to be executed when a specific signal is received.

methods.name: registerLogger
methods.description: Registers signal handlers for TERM, HUP, and INT signals to log their reception.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a handler for a specific signal, with optional logging of failures.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Internal method to register a signal handler with a fail message and optional stack trace logging.
